### Data Attributes {#dialog-data-attributes}

| Attribute                                           | Applied when                                                                                                    | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| data-slot="root"                                    | Always on `Dialog.Panel`                                                                                        | Stable root selector for the dialog container. Carries `data-variant`, `data-header-type`, `data-mask-variant`, and the `tk-dialog` class (plus the variant-specific class). |
| data-slot="mask"                                    | When `Dialog.Mask` is rendered and the dialog is visible                                                        | Stable backdrop selector. Adds the mask variant class plus `data-mask-variant`, `data-backdrop-hidden`, and `data-mask-blur` hooks.                                          |
| data-slot="header"                                  | On `Dialog.Header`                                                                                              | Stable header band selector. Carries the header type class and `data-header-type`.                                                                                           |
| data-slot="sign-icon"                               | On `Dialog.SignIcon`                                                                                            | Stable selector for the variant sign treatment.                                                                                                                              |
| data-slot="title-container"                         | On `Dialog.TitleGroup`                                                                                          | Stable selector that wraps the title and description.                                                                                                                        |
| data-slot="title"                                   | On `Dialog.Title`                                                                                               | Stable selector for the dialog title.                                                                                                                                        |
| data-slot="subtitle"                                | On `Dialog.Description`                                                                                         | Stable selector for the dialog description copy.                                                                                                                             |
| data-slot="close-button"                            | On `Dialog.CloseButton`                                                                                         | Stable selector for the header close action. Activation calls `requestClose()` from dialog context.                                                                          |
| data-slot="content"                                 | On `Dialog.Body`                                                                                                | Stable selector for the main dialog content region.                                                                                                                          |
| data-slot="footer"                                  | On `Dialog.Footer`                                                                                              | Stable selector for the footer band.                                                                                                                                         |
| data-slot="footer-actions"                          | On `Dialog.FooterActions`                                                                                       | Stable selector for the actions group inside the footer.                                                                                                                     |
| data-variant / data-header-type / data-mask-variant | Always on `Dialog.Panel`; `data-mask-variant` also on `Dialog.Mask`; `data-header-type` also on `Dialog.Header` | Product styling hooks for dialog tone, header treatment, and mask treatment.                                                                                                 |
| data-backdrop-hidden / data-mask-blur               | When the corresponding visual prop is enabled                                                                   | Mask styling hooks for transparent and blurred backdrops.                                                                                                                    |
